lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three distinct horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters; the mid-flank row exhibits the highest regularity in centroid spacing posterior to the fifth branchial slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition (light upper margin to shadowed lower margin) along the mid and upper flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 10-12 discrete high-luminance circular blobs within the dorsal fin mask, concentrated primarily in the basal and posterior regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular notch visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; minor surface irregularities on the leading edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Cluster of small, elongated mid-luminance objects (teleost fish) visible in the ventral-anterior region proximal to the pectoral fin and gills.
